Announcing Pangea Split, a new exhibition of contemporary design-based works by Mound. Pangea Split will present recent painterly and structural experimentations within the Laminar line of epoxy resin furniture by Mound.
Mound is a design and fabrication house, born in a global pandemic and designing with end-times flair. We concern ourselves with Post-Lifestyle design: objects blind to feeble trends and bottomless pit consumption. To those early modernist shamans, who said design can better someone’s life and nourish the interior self, we listened and learned.

candidates.description:
A new physical theatre production is bringing a powerful story of survival and community to the stage this October! Sarajevo Will Be (Everything Else Will Pass) from Yeda Theatre Productions explores the story of La Benevolencija, a Jewish humanitarian organization that continued operating throughout the 1992–95 siege of Sarajevo.

The show combines movement, live violin and accordion, shadow puppetry, and recorded interviews with people who lived through the war. It follows Tea, a present-day violinist who inherits her father’s instrument and begins uncovering the story he never told her.
